note: TransformerPath Transformer Exhibition Directory — a verified, curated subset of transformer-relevant exhibitions, trade shows, conferences and industry events. Every entry carries a verification_status and verification_date reflecting a website check on the recorded date; the official event website was confirmed as current and transformer-relevant. Entries are informational listings and do not imply endorsement, verification of event quality, or commercial affiliation. Transformer focus is graded: 'Primary' (explicit transformer/electrical-manufacturing scope), 'Major' (significant T&D/power-transmission content), 'Secondary' (transformer presence within a broader energy/industrial scope). An event whose website is defunct, redirected, or cancelled is marked Inactive/Cancelled and excluded from the live directory. Several events have been rebranded or merged since earlier references: African Utility Week is now Enlit Africa, POWER-GEN Asia & Asian Utility Week have merged into Enlit Asia, and European Utility Week has been absorbed into Enlit Europe — each is recorded once under its current name.
verified_workflow: For each event the official website was located by search, then confirmed to (a) exist and be scheduled for the stated dates, (b) match the event name and organizer, (c) be current (not an archived or past-event page), and (d) show transformer-relevant content. Dates, venue, city and organizer were taken from the official site; where a figure (exhibition area, exhibitor or visitor count) was not published on the official site it is left null rather than inferred.

entries.transformer_focus: Primary - Coil-winding and electrical-manufacturing event covering the transformer value chain
entries.description: The world's leading coil-winding, insulation and electrical-manufacturing exhibition, at Messe Berlin. It is the closest trade show to the transformer supply chain — insulation papers/pressboard, conductor/CTC, magnetic core and laminations, cooling radiators and winding machines — a key sourcing event for transformer OEMs and their component suppliers.

entries.venue: Shanghai World Expo Exhibition & Convention Center
entries.transformer_focus: Primary - Electrical-manufacturing event for China's transformer, motor and generator base
entries.description: The Asian edition of CWIEME, the supply-chain hub for China's enormous transformer, motor and generator manufacturing base. Magnetic steel, insulation, wire, cores and components, plus finished electrical equipment — a key window into the world's largest transformer market and manufacturing base.

entries.transformer_focus: Major - North America's largest T&D event; power/distribution transformers and reactors are core content
entries.description: North America's largest transmission & distribution conference and exposition, at McCormick Place Chicago. With US grid hardening, renewables and data-centre load growth, it is where power transformer, distribution transformer, reactor and substation suppliers meet the utilities that need them.

entries.organizer: CIGRE (International Council on Large Electric Systems)
entries.transformer_focus: Primary - A2 Transformer study committee is the technical heartbeat of the industry
entries.description: The pre-eminent global power-systems conference and session of CIGRE. The A2 (Transformers) study committee covers power and distribution transformer design, condition monitoring, HVDC converter transformers and diagnostics — the leading technical gathering for the transformer community worldwide, paired with the CIGRE exhibition.

entries.transformer_focus: Secondary - Smart-grid and energy-transition technology conference; grid/transformer content present
entries.description: The IEEE Power & Energy Society's Innovative Smart Grid Technologies (ISGT) conference for Europe, in Budapest. It covers smart grids, grid modernisation, renewables integration and power-system technology — including the transformer, grid-equipment and monitoring content behind the European grid transition.

entries.transformer_focus: Major - Gulf power & energy exhibition with a strong T&D and transformer supplier base
entries.description: The Gulf's flagship power and energy exhibition, at the Dubai World Trade Centre. Fifty editions of T&D, generation, renewables and smart-grid content make it the region's busiest window for transformer, switchgear and substation sourcing — a key event for suppliers selling into the GCC projects boom.

entries.transformer_focus: Major - Smart-grid and T&D event with distribution transformer and grid-equipment content
entries.description: The leading transmission & distribution, smart-grid and distribution-automation event in North America, at the San Diego Convention Center. It covers grid modernisation, distribution assets and T&D technology — including distribution transformer, switchgear and grid-monitoring content.

entries.transformer_focus: Secondary - Power-generation event; generator step-up and grid-connection transformers present
entries.description: The largest power-generation event in the world, at the San Antonio Convention Center. It covers generation, grid integration and the power industry's technology — including generator step-up (GSU) transformers, power transformers and grid-connection equipment supporting generation and data-centre load.

entries.transformer_focus: Primary - India's flagship electrical exposition; power and distribution transformer OEMs are core exhibitors
entries.description: The flagship Indian electrical and power exhibition, at India Expo Mart, Greater Noida. The world's largest electrical-economy show by footprint, covering generation, T&D, transformers, switchgear and automation — essential for the Indian transformer market and its export base.

entries.transformer_focus: Major - European energy-transition exhibition; grid and transformer content across the energy transition
entries.description: Europe's leading energy-transition exhibition at Messe Wien, covering generation, transmission and distribution, grid modernisation, smart metering and renewables. It is a major window for the transformer, switchgear and substation suppliers serving the European grid build-out.

entries.transformer_focus: Major - Gulf water, energy and environment exhibition; grid/renewable integration drives transformer demand
entries.description: The Water, Energy, Technology and Environment Exhibition (WETEX), under DEWA, co-located with the Dubai Solar Show at the Dubai World Trade Centre. It is a Gulf focus point for sustainability, renewable integration and the grids that support them — including transformer, GSU and reactor supply.

entries.transformer_focus: Secondary - Industrial-technology fair; electrical-manufacturing and energy content relevant to transformers
entries.description: The world's leading industrial-technology trade fair at the Hannover Exhibition Grounds. It spans industrial automation, energy and the supply chain for electrical machines and transformers — a European venue to see transformer manufacturing technology, drives and grid equipment.

entries.transformer_focus: Primary - Electrical and industrial expo featuring Türkiye's strong transformer and component OEM base
entries.description: Türkiye's largest industrial and electrical tradeshow at the Istanbul Expo Center, including the Electrotech Eurasia electrical section. It showcases the substantial Turkish transformer and component OEM network that exports across Europe, Africa and the Middle East.

entries.transformer_focus: Major - Asia-Pacific energy-transition and grid event; T&D and transformer content present
entries.description: The Asia-Pacific edition of Enlit, in Jakarta — a power and energy exhibition covering the region's energy transition, generation, T&D and grid modernisation. It is a window into the dense Asian utility and grid-equipment market, including transformer and substation supplier activity.

entries.transformer_focus: Secondary - Mining and industrial-power show; substation and transformer content present
entries.description: Africa's largest mining and industrial-power exhibition, at the Nasrec Expo Centre, Johannesburg. It covers mining, industrial electrification and the power infrastructure that supports them — including substation, transformer and switchgear supply for the African industrial and mining sector.

entries.transformer_focus: Major - North America's largest power-systems technical conference with deep transformer content
entries.description: The IEEE Power & Energy Society's flagship technical conference. It is the largest North American power-systems technical meeting, with deep transformer, grid and HVDC content and the utility R&D community in attendance.

entries.event_name: 7th International Colloquium Transformer Research & Asset Management (ICTRAM 2026)
entries.organizer: CIGRE (International Council on Large Electric Systems) / ICTRAM
entries.transformer_focus: Primary - The world's most transformer-specific technical colloquium (A2/transformer research & asset management)
entries.description: The International Colloquium on Transformer Research and Asset Management (ICTRAM), promoted by CIGRE, in Cavtat. It is the most transformer-specific technical gathering — focused on transformer design, condition monitoring, diagnostics, life management and asset management — a leading venue for the transformer engineering and research community.

entries.organizer: CIGRE (International Council on Large Electric Systems)
entries.transformer_focus: Major - CIGRE power-system symposium; transformer and high-voltage study-committee content
entries.description: A CIGRE international symposium in Heidelberg, on power-system and T&D engineering, including transformer and high-voltage content plus the grid and renewables build-out driving European demand.

entries.transformer_focus: Primary - Dedicated transformer technology conference (instrument & control, diagnostics, monitoring)
entries.description: MegaWhat Transformer I&C Days, hosted by Hitachi Energy, is a dedicated transformer technology conference focused on instrumentation and control, diagnostics and condition monitoring. It is a specialist event squarely on the transformer — suitable for transformer engineers, utilities and asset managers.

entries.organizer: CIGRE (National Committee GCC / Gulf power community)
entries.transformer_focus: Primary - Gulf CIGRE power conference with a focus on GCC T&D and transformer demand
entries.description: The Gulf Cooperation Council power conference and CIGRE technical event, focused on the GCC grid, T&D build-out, and the substation and transformer investment the regional projects boom is driving. A key window into Gulf transformer demand.

entries.transformer_focus: Major - Pan-African power and energy event; grid, T&D and utility content with transformer presence
entries.description: Enlit Africa, the rebrand of African Utility Week, is the flagship pan-African power, energy and water event at the Cape Town International Convention Centre. It covers generation, transmission and distribution, grid modernisation and utility investment, and is a key window into the transformer, substation and grid-equipment market serving Africa.

entries.transformer_focus: Secondary - Nordic power and electrical tradeshow; grid and transformer content present
entries.description: ELFACK is the Nordic region's leading electrical, power and energy tradeshow at Svenska Mässan, Gothenburg. It covers power distribution, electrical installation, grid technology and the energy transition — including transformer, switchgear and substation equipment for the Scandinavian grid and industry.
